book.title: Career and Technical Education Grade 7 Student Textbook
book.subject: cte

title: Types of soft skills
competency: Describe personal and interpersonal soft skills, creative thinking and problem solving.

keywords.def: Qualities inside one person, like self-decision making, flexibility and curiosity.
Skills used with others, like communication, collaboration, teamwork and listening.
The skill of generating new ideas and new ways of working.
The skill of identifying a problem and finding a solution.

en.text: Soft skills include self-awareness, time management, communication, teamwork, good manners, respect, self-confidence, listening and collaboration. Personal soft skills are inside one person, like self-decision making. Interpersonal soft skills work with others, like collaboration in a group assignment.

screens.title: Your own study plan
screens.ask: You make your own study plan without anyone telling you. Which skill is this?
screens.after: Doing what is expected without waiting to be told is self-decision making, a personal soft skill.

screens.title: 2.2.2 Types of soft skills
paras: Soft skills include self-awareness, time management, communication and teamwork.
They also include good manners, respect, self-confidence, listening and collaboration.
Soft skills can be personal or interpersonal.

screens.title: Personal and interpersonal
table: Self-decision making, flexibility, attention to detail, curiosity
Communication, collaboration, teamwork, listening, time management
Example: making your own study plan
Example: working with your group on an assignment

screens.title: Key words
defs: Qualities inside one person, like self-decision making, flexibility and curiosity.
Skills used with others, like communication, collaboration, teamwork and listening.

screens.why: Personal skills are inside you; interpersonal skills are used with others.
screens.clue: Do you need another person to use it?

screens.text: Your teacher gives a group assignment. You share the work with your group. Which skill is this?
screens.why: Working with others to finish a task is collaboration.

screens.text: You were late to school. Which soft skill helps you avoid being late?
screens.why: Planning your time — sleeping early, preparing your bag, leaving early — is time management.
screens.clue: Which skill is about using time well?

screens.text: Soft skills do not support students to learn.
screens.why: Making a study plan and working in groups are soft skills that help you learn.
screens.clue: Think of the study plan example.

screens.text: Bereket is curious and decides things for himself, but he never listens in group work. Which type of soft skill should he build?
screens.why: Curiosity and self-decision are personal skills he already has. Listening in a group is an interpersonal skill.

en.text: Creative thinking is the ability to see something in a new way: a new approach, a new solution, a new result. It is thinking outside the box. Phones, radios, knives and sewing machines all came from creative thinking. Unsolved problems and curiosity trigger it.

screens.title: Your pen
screens.ask: Is the pen you are using a result of creative thinking?
screens.after: Yes. Someone found a new, easier way to write. Every technology we use came from creative thinking.

screens.title: Creative thinking
paras: Creative thinking is the ability to consider something in a new way.
It may be a new approach to a problem or a solution to a conflict.
It means thinking outside the box: outside the usual way.
Mobile phones and musical instruments came from creative thinking.

screens.title: The "aha" moment
paras: Anything with an "aha" moment is creative.
New ideas solve problems and increase productivity.
Unsolved problems and curiosity are the main triggers of creative thinking.

screens.title: To think creatively, you have to:
paras: Examine things carefully to know what they mean.
Avoid biases or wrong assumptions; look at things in a new way.
Present and communicate your idea so others understand and accept it.
Observe carefully and ask questions to know more.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The skill of generating new ideas and new ways of working.

screens.text: What are the main triggers of creative thinking?
screens.why: The book names these two triggers.

screens.text: The number of people with a disease is rising. How can you show this other than writing a report?
screens.why: Showing the same facts in a new way, like a graph, is creative thinking.
screens.clue: Think of a picture of numbers.

screens.text: Creative thinking means always doing things the usual way.
screens.why: It means thinking outside the box.

screens.text: Your friend says 1 + 1 = 3. What is a creative-thinking reaction?
opts: Ask how he got 3, then show him calmly with objects
screens.ans: Ask how he got 3, then show him calmly with objects
screens.why: Avoid bias, ask questions, and communicate clearly.
screens.clue: Which steps does the book list?

screens.text: Water from the school tap is wasted because the tap leaks. Which is the most creative idea?
opts: Put a bucket under it and use the water for the school garden
screens.ans: Put a bucket under it and use the water for the school garden
screens.why: It turns a problem into a benefit: a new way of doing things. (Fixing the tap is also wise.)
screens.clue: Which idea brings a new benefit?

en.text: Problem solving is the skill of finding the best solution to a problem. Its steps: know the problem, find its cause, develop and select alternative solutions, apply the chosen one and check if the problem is solved. Covering an exercise book with plastic, not paper, is an example.

screens.title: Covering your book
screens.ask: Your exercise book gets dirty and torn. Which cover solves the problem best?
screens.after: Paper gets dirty and tears when wet. Plastic protects it. Choosing the best solution is problem solving.

screens.title: Problem solving
paras: Problem solving uses methods and skills to find the best solution to a problem.
It is the ability to handle difficult or unexpected situations.
The problem may be about a task, a situation or a person.

screens.title: The steps, with the exercise book
steps: Know the problem: the exercise book gets dirty and torn.
Find the cause: splashes of liquid and mud.
Develop alternatives: a paper cover or a plastic cover.
Select one: paper gets dirty and tears; plastic protects. Choose plastic.
Apply it and check: is the book now clean and safe?

screens.title: Key words
defs: The skill of identifying a problem and finding a solution.

screens.why: This is the order the book gives.
screens.clue: You must know the problem before you can find its cause.

screens.text: Why is paper not the right cover for an exercise book?
opts: It gets dirty and is damaged by liquid
screens.ans: It gets dirty and is damaged by liquid
screens.why: The book says paper accumulates dirt and is damaged by liquid.

screens.text: Being open-minded is an obstacle to problem solving.
screens.why: An open mind helps you find and compare alternative solutions.
screens.clue: Can you choose a solution without considering alternatives?

screens.text: Which comes first: careful thinking about the problem, or the solution?
screens.why: You must know the problem and its cause before choosing a solution.
screens.clue: Look at the order of the steps.

screens.text: Rubbish is thrown near your school gate. You put a box there as a bin. What is the next step in problem solving?
opts: Check after a week whether the area is cleaner
screens.ans: Check after a week whether the area is cleaner
screens.why: After applying a solution, you check if the problem is solved.

items.text: What should you do to avoid being late to school?
opts: Sleep early, prepare your bag at night and leave early
items.ans: Sleep early, prepare your bag at night and leave early

items.text: The pen or pencil you use is a result of creative thinking.
items.why: Every technology we use came from creative thinking.

items.text: How can you show a rise in infections other than writing a report?
opts: A graph, table, poster or drama
items.ans: A graph, table, poster or drama
items.why: Showing data in a new way is creative.

test.text: Which one is an interpersonal soft skill?
Creative thinking means thinking outside the box.
What is the first step of problem solving?
test.why: You must first know the problem.

test.ask: Unsolved problems and ___ are the main triggers of creative thinking.
test.why: The two triggers are unsolved problems and curiosity.

test.text: Hirut compares two ways to carry water, picks the cheaper safe one, uses it, then checks it works. Which skill is this?
